n0b2a3aa0f80.s: How much was allocated to the Price Stabilisation Fund in Andhra Pradesh's Agriculture and Allied Sectors Budget 2026-27?
n0b2a3aa0f80.x: The Price Stabilisation Fund got ₹500 crore; ₹14,277 crore went to irrigation (the largest head) and ₹13,722 crore to the farm-power subsidy.

na8839ae659b.s: The Agriculture and Allied Sectors Budget presented by K. Atchannaidu on 14 February 2026 was his:
na8839ae659b.x: It was K. Atchannaidu's third Agriculture Budget, not his first.

n5655d7a2007.s: The latest infant mortality rate (IMR) of Andhra Pradesh is:
n5655d7a2007.x: Andhra Pradesh's IMR is 19, below the cited Indian IMR of 25; its TFR is 1.5.

n23d13ef19cd.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about literacy in Andhra Pradesh as per Census 2011?
o: The literacy rate of Andhra Pradesh was 67.35%
Female literacy in Andhra Pradesh was 59.96%
Andhra Pradesh's literacy rate was higher than the all-India rate
n23d13ef19cd.x: Andhra Pradesh's literacy rate of 67.35% was lower, not higher, than India's 72.98%.

n413f60112f7.s: During the 2026 Budget session of Andhra Pradesh, the Socio-Economic Survey was:
o: Presented before the Budget on 14 February 2026
Replaced by the Finance Commission report
Tabled along with the 2024-25 Finance Accounts
n413f60112f7.x: The Socio-Economic Survey was skipped during the 2026 Budget session.

ca0dd8ebc9de81.s: The Global Horticulture Hub–Rayalaseema Rising project covers 10 districts, 5,869 villages and how many mandals?
ca0dd8ebc9de81.x: It covers 303 mandals; 201 is the number of horticulture clusters.

cadd8c8382dea3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Global Horticulture Hub–Rayalaseema Rising project?
o: It is valued at about ₹1 lakh crore
Its private investment share is larger than its government share
cadd8c8382dea3.x: The project is not fully government-funded; private investment forms the larger share.

ca51d19cfddd27.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about feeder-level solarisation under PM-KUSUM?
o: Under the CAPEX mode, the utility owns the project
Under the CAPEX mode, a service company owns the project
Under the RESCO mode, a service company operates the project
The RESCO mode has a normal period of 25 years
ca51d19cfddd27.x: In the CAPEX mode the utility, not a service company, owns the project; the service company belongs to the RESCO mode (normal period 25 years).

ca8dee5f61acd1.s: Megha Engineering's cancelled 2,000 MW project at Kommuru in Annamayya district was a:
ca8dee5f61acd1.x: The cancelled Megha Engineering project at Kommuru was a 2,000 MW pumped-hydro project, not a solar project.

cac88693fc49a9.s: How many portable box-sized 4-Kelvin testing systems make up Q-SHIVA, unveiled at the Pan-IIT DeepTech Conference in Vijayawada?
cac88693fc49a9.x: Q-SHIVA comprises five portable box-sized 4-Kelvin testing systems made in India that cool in 1–2 hours.

ca8bb5f1a1b5ac.s: How many sector-specific industrial parks will Andhra Pradesh receive under BHAVYA?
ca8bb5f1a1b5ac.x: Andhra Pradesh is to receive 11 parks under BHAVYA; the Robotics Park is in Sri Sathya Sai and the Semiconductor Park in Tirupati.

ca8a21fd26a1cd.s: The annual capacity of the proposed Mazagon Dock merchant shipyard at Dugarajapatnam is:
ca8a21fd26a1cd.x: The shipyard's capacity is 1.2 million gross tonnes a year; MDL's investment is about ₹15,000 crore with about 45,000 jobs.

cae9941e0a6e96.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Krishna river-water sharing?
o: Article 262 assigns adjudication of inter-State river disputes to Parliament
The Krishna River Management Board was set up under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014
One TMC-ft is approximately 28.32 billion cubic metres
The Inter-State River Water Disputes Act was enacted in 1956
cae9941e0a6e96.x: One TMC-ft is about 28.32 million, not billion, cubic metres.

cae03097f81fa9.s: Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision 2047 aims to place India among the top ____ shipbuilders of the world by 2047.
cae03097f81fa9.x: Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision 2047 aims for India to be among the top 5 shipbuilders by 2047, not the top 3.

cac35f420eaf40.s: The 28.95 km bituminous concrete road record on NH-544G began at Sadarlapalli in which constituency?
cac35f420eaf40.x: The record work began at Sadarlapalli in the Puttaparthi constituency of Sri Sathya Sai district.

ca6cda86102c01.s: Penukonda, where a Vijayanagara-era inscription with eight Naga Kanyas worshipping Shiva was found, was the ____ capital of the Vijayanagara Empire.
ca6cda86102c01.x: Penukonda was the second capital of the Vijayanagara Empire.

ca0344402a2aaf.s: Which Municipal Corporation's mayoral post is reserved for the Scheduled Tribes in Andhra Pradesh?
ca0344402a2aaf.x: Mangalagiri–Tadepalli has the ST reservation; Kurnool is SC, Kakinada is BC Women and Tirupati is unreserved.

caaadfd3f9dff5.s: As per the ASUSE district data, which Andhra Pradesh district recorded the highest annual wage of ₹1,99,783?
caaadfd3f9dff5.x: Kakinada recorded the highest annual wage; Kurnool recorded the lowest at ₹1,11,549.

ca970d6a059970.s: Papikonda National Park lies in the:
o: Northern Eastern Ghats along the Godavari
Southern Eastern Ghats along the Krishna
ca970d6a059970.x: Papikonda lies in the northern Eastern Ghats along the Godavari, not in the Western Ghats.

ca37eb204f70a7.s: Which vector is associated with Plasmodium falciparum malaria in Andhra Pradesh?
ca37eb204f70a7.x: Female Anopheles is the vector associated with Plasmodium falciparum.

ca3d77f42fdeaf.s: Phase I of the Veligonda Project has a water allocation of:
ca3d77f42fdeaf.x: Phase I has 10.70 TMC and supplies drinking water to 4 lakh people; it irrigates 1.19 lakh acres.

cadc5208fc86af.s: Where was Krishna water released when Phase I of the Veligonda Project was inaugurated on 31 August 2026?
cadc5208fc86af.x: Krishna water was released at Ghantavanipalli in Dornala mandal, Markapuram district, not at Nallamala Sagar.

ca01cedcbce71e.x: The Krishna rises near Mahabaleshwar, not near the Srisailam Reservoir.

ca504e61c5bff1.s: APTDC plans to introduce which boats at tourist destinations in phases?
ca504e61c5bff1.x: APTDC plans the phased introduction of solar-powered and electric boats; it has also invited private participation through PPP.

ca953f99fb4d50.s: The Yogandhra-2026 campaign targeted the participation of about:
ca953f99fb4d50.x: The campaign targeted 1 crore people; 2.5 lakh were to be trained in a five-day programme, across all 28 districts.

ca51fb91d85d76.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Clean Godavari initiative?
o: The Centre assured support for the Mission Godavari Clean Project on the lines of Namami Gange
The Pushkaram theme is "Swachh Godavari, Pavitra Pushkaralu"
260 model panchayats along the Godavari were included under Viksit Bharat-Gram Gaurav
A CPCB team will assess Godavari pollution after the next Godavari Pushkarams
ca51fb91d85d76.x: The CPCB assessment is to be done before, not after, the next Godavari Pushkarams.

ca9cfddefc0821.s: Andhra Pradesh's first semiconductor packaging unit, by ASIP Technologies with APACT Co., is being set up at a cost of about:
ca9cfddefc0821.x: The unit costs about ₹2,387 crore, not ₹4,750 crore; it is the first OSAT centre in South India under the ISM.

caf4d6952bc0d4.s: India's first non-GMO, high-expansion popcorn maize hybrids were developed with:
caf4d6952bc0d4.x: The hybrids were developed with ICAR–Indian Institute of Maize Research, not the National Health Authority.

ca99e740968c4c.s: Maize, for which India's first non-GMO high-expansion popcorn hybrid was released, is India's ____ most important food crop after rice and wheat.
ca99e740968c4c.x: Maize (Zea mays) ranks third after rice and wheat. A sequence question was not possible as the facts carry no dates.

cafd682939016f.s: The India Semiconductor Mission was launched in:
cafd682939016f.x: The India Semiconductor Mission was launched in 2021; Andhra Pradesh's Semiconductor and Display Fab Policy covers 2024–2029.

cac2a544372378.s: The AP State Action Plan on Climate Change 2025–30 identified the energy sector of which region as the most vulnerable?
cac2a544372378.x: The energy sector in northern and central Andhra Pradesh was identified as the most vulnerable.

ca4c78c278f4d1.s: In the solar Centre of Excellence at IIT Tirupati, which body provides the academic infrastructure, faculty and research?
ca4c78c278f4d1.x: IIT Tirupati provides academic infrastructure, faculty and research; the CoE for Energy Transition handles funding and coordination.

cacecc5821b11e.s: The MoUs of the revived Kakinada Special Economic Zone involve investments of about:
cacecc5821b11e.x: The MoUs total about ₹1.5 lakh crore with potential for 1.5 lakh direct and indirect jobs.

ca4901899f7c72.s: Under the APEX Korea outreach, the Hwaseung footwear unit is located at:
ca4901899f7c72.x: The Hwaseung unit is in Kuppam, not Visakhapatnam.

caad63557d57d1.s: APTDC's board meeting was held aboard a caravan travelling from Vijayawada to:
caad63557d57d1.x: The APTDC board met aboard a caravan travelling from Vijayawada to Suryalanka Beach near Bapatla.

ca7827edbd1a21.s: During the Chief Minister's Singapore visit, YCH Logistics Group was linked to:
o: Logistics parks and a supply-chain city
A task force on AI and cloud computing
ca7827edbd1a21.x: YCH Logistics Group was linked to logistics parks and a supply-chain city; UN-Habitat to a Centre of Excellence and NUS to an Amaravati campus.

ca500fd22793e6.s: Under the City Economic Region scheme, each selected city receives:
ca500fd22793e6.x: Each city receives ₹5,000 crore: ₹3,500 crore from the Centre and ₹1,500 crore in State loans.

caa9b03494ee51.s: The scientific name of the Asian elephant, India's National Heritage Animal, is:
caa9b03494ee51.x: The Asian elephant is Elephas maximus, listed in Schedule I and CITES Appendix I.

ca4994fcbc1284.s: The Andhra Pradesh–CSIR–NGRI pact on lithium and gallium was signed on:
ca4994fcbc1284.x: The pact was signed on 12 August 2026; lithium was recorded up to 1,000 ppm and gallium up to 250 ppm.

ca4919d0ed3a0d.s: Which district is the worst affected by coastal erosion in Andhra Pradesh as per the Shoreline Management Plan?
ca4919d0ed3a0d.x: Kakinada has the highest erosion share (52.99%); Vizianagaram has only 3.26% with high accretion.

ca52bbd6b66dec.s: Pulicat Lake and Sriharikota, vulnerable stretches in the AP Shoreline Management Plan, are in which district?
ca52bbd6b66dec.x: Pulicat Lake and Sriharikota are in Tirupati; Machilipatnam is in Krishna and Hope Island in Kakinada.

new.s: What is the total outlay of the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27?
new.x: The total outlay is ₹3,32,205 crore, nearly the same as 2025-26; ₹2,56,143 crore is the revenue expenditure.

new.s: The fiscal-deficit target of Andhra Pradesh for 2026-27 is:
new.x: The fiscal deficit target is ₹75,868 crore or 3.8% of GSDP; 1.1% is the revenue-deficit target and 4.3% the Centre's target.

new.s: The revenue expenditure in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27 is:
new.x: Revenue expenditure is ₹2,56,143 crore, out of a total outlay of ₹3,32,205 crore.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27:
1. The revenue deficit target is 1.1% of GSDP.
2. The fiscal deficit target is higher than the Centre's target of 4.3% of GDP.
3. GSDP is projected to grow by 12%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The revenue deficit target is 1.1% and GSDP growth is projected at 12%; AP's fiscal deficit target of 3.8% is lower than the Centre's 4.3%.

new.s: How much has been allocated to the Polavaram project in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27?
new.x: Polavaram got ₹6,105 crore; ₹9,668 crore is for Thalliki Vandanam and ₹4,000 crore for NTR Vaidya Seva.

new.s: Which pair of Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27 allocations is correctly matched?
o: Health, Medical and Family Welfare – ₹32,308 crore
new.x: School Education got ₹32,308 crore; Health got ₹19,306 crore, Thalliki Vandanam ₹9,668 crore and Tribal Welfare ₹4,765 crore.

new.s: Which department received ₹34,350 crore in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27?
new.x: The BC Welfare Department got ₹34,350 crore (BC component ₹51,021 crore); Social Welfare got ₹11,118 crore.

new.s: When was the Swarna Andhra @2047 vision document unveiled?
new.x: CM N. Chandrababu Naidu unveiled Swarna Andhra @2047 at Vijayawada on 13 December 2024.

new.s: The guiding principles of Swarna Andhra @2047, known as Padi Sutralu, number:
new.x: Swarna Andhra @2047 has 10 guiding principles (Padi Sutralu); its theme is "10 Principles - One Vision".

new.s: Swarna Andhra @2047 targets an Andhra Pradesh economy of what size by 2047?
new.x: The target is a $2.4 trillion economy by 2047, with growth of 15% a year or more.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh's vision strategy, P4 stands for:
new.x: P4 = Public-Private-People Partnership, linked to the zero-poverty goal of Swarna Andhra @2047.

new.s: Which body is the main execution agency for the Swarna Andhra @2047 roadmap?
new.x: The AP State Development Planning Society (APSDPS) is the main execution body for the roadmap.

new.s: The per capita income of Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26 (Advance Estimates) is:
new.x: Per capita income rose to ₹2,94,507 from ₹2,66,699 (about 10.43% growth); ₹6,58,964 is Visakhapatnam's.

new.s: Which district has the highest per capita income in Andhra Pradesh (2025-26 AE)?
new.x: Visakhapatnam has the highest per capita income (₹6,58,964); Krishna comes next.

new.s: The nominal GSDP growth of Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26 (Advance Estimates) was:
new.x: GSDP rose from ₹15.91 lakh crore to ₹17.62 lakh crore, a nominal growth of 10.75%; 10.43% is per capita income growth.

new.s: What is the share of agriculture in Andhra Pradesh's GSDP (2025-26 AE)?
new.x: Agriculture accounts for 33.20% (about one-third) of GSDP; 36.04% is the debt-GSDP ratio.

new.s: Revenue-deficit grants to Andhra Pradesh ended under which Finance Commission?
new.x: Revenue-deficit grants ended under the 16th Finance Commission.

new.s: The outstanding debt of Andhra Pradesh is expected to reach about what amount by the end of 2026-27?
new.x: Debt of ₹6,35,177 crore (2025-26 RE) is expected to reach ₹7,11,094 crore by end of 2026-27; ₹3,11,182 crore is guarantees.

new.s: The Andhra Pradesh Rural Inclusive Growth Project (APRIGP) is funded by:
new.x: APRIGP is a World Bank (IDA, $75 million) project for higher farm incomes and human development services in backward mandals.

new.s: Which externally aided project in Andhra Pradesh is wrongly matched with its funding agency?
o: AP Economic Restructuring Project – World Bank
new.x: APILIP-II is funded by JICA, not the World Bank.

new.s: The AP Economic Restructuring Project, signed in 1999 with the World Bank, aimed at:
o: Repair of major district roads and State highways
Fiscal reform plus primary health, nutrition, primary education and rural assets
new.x: APERP combined fiscal reform with primary health, nutrition, primary education and rural assets; tank villages are APIIATP and learning outcomes SALT.

new.s: The maternal mortality ratio (MMR) of Andhra Pradesh as per SRS 2021-23 is:
new.x: AP's MMR is 30 (it was 45 in SES 2024-25), against India's 88; 19 is the IMR.

new.s: NSHIP-AP, the SPV for the Dugarajapatnam shipyard, is owned equally by the AP Maritime Board and:
new.x: NSHIP-AP is owned equally by the AP Maritime Board and the Visakhapatnam Port Authority.

new.s: The Kakinada Gateway Port is being developed by:
new.x: Kakinada Gateway Port is an Aurobindo Group PPP project; Machilipatnam port is being built by MEIL.

new.s: How much cargo did Andhra Pradesh ports handle in 2025-26?
new.x: AP ports handled about 210 MMT; 91.17 MMT was Visakhapatnam port's, and 327.5 MMT is the combined capacity.

new.s: The South Coast Railway zone, which began operations on 1 June 2026, is headquartered at:
new.x: South Coast Railway, India's 18th zone, has its headquarters at Visakhapatnam.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a division of the South Coast Railway zone?
new.x: SCoR's divisions are Guntakal, Guntur, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam (renamed Waltair).

new.s: The Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram was built by GMR on which model?
new.x: GMR (GVIAL) built the airport on the DBFOT public-private partnership model.

new.s: The ADB and Japan financed a green ammonia project of AM Green Ammonia at:
new.x: ADB and Japan signed financing with AM Green Ammonia for a green ammonia project at Kakinada.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Kakinada green ammonia project:
1. Its capacity is about 1.1 million tonnes a year.
2. It is the first investment under ACCEL.
3. Its loan comes via LEAP 2, administered by JICA.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Capacity is about 1.1 million tonnes a year and it is ACCEL's first investment; LEAP 2 is funded by JICA but administered by ADB.

new.s: The 800 MW Avuku pumped storage project cancelled by the Cabinet in September 2026 belonged to:
new.x: The Cabinet cancelled RVR Projects' 800 MW Avuku PSP; Megha Engineering's cancelled project was at Kommuru.

new.s: What is the capacity of Premier Energies' N-Type TOPCon cell plant at Naidupeta?
new.x: The Naidupeta plant is 7 GW; 10.6 GW is the company's total cell capacity.

new.s: How many acres have been allotted for Andhra Pradesh's BHAVYA industrial parks?
new.x: AP's 11 BHAVYA parks have 4,757 acres allotted; 3,488 acres is the Dugarajapatnam cluster site.

new.s: What rank did Andhra Pradesh hold among Indian States in exports in 2025-26?
new.x: AP ranked 7th with ₹1.77 lakh crore (4.53%); Gujarat was 1st and Kerala 15th.

new.s: The Indian School of Agriculture, whose foundation was laid with the Global Horticulture Hub launch, is being set up with:
new.x: The Indian School of Agriculture is being set up with Reliance, modelled on ISB.

new.s: Google's AI hub at Visakhapatnam is being developed with which partners?
new.x: Google's 1 GW AI data-centre campus partners are AdaniConneX and Airtel Nxtra.

new.s: What is the planned initial capacity of the Google AI data-centre campus at Visakhapatnam?
new.x: The campus is 1 GW, with a long-term capacity of 5 GW.

new.s: The IBM Quantum Computing Centre at Amaravati Quantum Valley Tech Park is a partnership of Andhra Pradesh with IBM and:
new.x: The centre is an AP partnership with IBM and TCS, using IBM superconducting quantum processors.

new.s: 'The Anchorage', India's first private integrated testing facility for fully reusable medium-lift launch vehicles, is in which district?
new.x: The Anchorage is at Space City, Tirupati district, near SDSC SHAR, Sriharikota.

new.s: The Polavaram Left Main Canal works, carrying Godavari water to Uttarandhra, are meant to irrigate about:
new.x: The canal plan irrigates 4 lakh acres and provides drinking water to 9.23 lakh people.

new.s: About what share of Polavaram project works had been completed by 2019?
new.x: About 72% of Polavaram works were done by 2019; the diaphragm wall was damaged later.

new.s: The Vijayawada Metro Rail Phase-I approved by the State has a length of:
new.x: Vijayawada Phase-I is 38.40 km with 34 stations; Visakhapatnam has 4 corridors over 76.90 km.

new.s: How many Municipal Corporations' mayoral posts are reserved for General Women in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Five corporations (Vizianagaram, Srikakulam, Guntur, Kadapa, Visakhapatnam) are General Women; four are unreserved.

new.s: Palle Panduga 3.0 was launched on 29 September 2026 at:
new.x: Palle Panduga 3.0 was launched at Udayagiri in Nellore district by CM Naidu and Dy CM Pawan Kalyan.

new.s: What is the total outlay of Palle Panduga 3.0?
new.x: The outlay is ₹11,085 crore: Centre ₹5,391 crore and State ₹5,694 crore.

new.s: Under Palle Panduga 3.0, the target for BT roads is:
new.x: The BT road target is 9,500 km; cement roads are 6,000 km and Mini Gokulams 22,000.

new.s: Which is the costliest of the eight Centre-funded tourism projects in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Suryalanka Beach (₹97.52 crore) is the costliest; Akhanda Godavari got ₹94.44 crore.

new.s: Ahobilam's tourism project falls under Swadesh Darshan 2.0 in which theme?
new.x: Ahobilam is under Swadesh Darshan 2.0 as a spiritual project, not beach.

new.s: The 10 new medical colleges in Andhra Pradesh are to be run under which model from 2027-28?
new.x: The 10 new medical colleges come up under PPP from 2027-28.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT among the 10 new PPP medical colleges in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: The 10 are Adoni, Madanapalle, Markapuram, Pulivendula, Penugonda, Palakollu, Amalapuram, Narsipatnam, Bapatla and Parvatipuram; Ongole is not one.

new.s: Krishna water reaches Nallamala Sagar under the Veligonda Project through:
new.x: Veligonda carries Krishna water from Srisailam by gravity through 18.8 km twin tunnels, not by lift.

new.s: The Recharla–Guravayigudem expressway inaugurated on 1 August 2026 lies on which National Highway?
new.x: The expressway is on the Khammam–Devarapalli NH-365BG; NH-67 has the Tadipatri bypass.

new.s: The capacity of the Kurnool-IV Renewable Energy Zone, whose transmission foundation was laid on 1 August 2026, is:
new.x: Kurnool-IV REZ is 4.5 GW; 2,500 MW and 1,000 MW are the Anantapur and Kurnool zones.

new.s: What is the runway length of the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram?
new.x: The airport has a 3,800 m runway and can withstand 275 kmph winds.

new.s: South Coast Railway began operations on 1 June 2026 as India's ____ railway zone.
new.x: SCoR, headquartered at Visakhapatnam, became the 18th railway zone.

new.s: The investment proposed for Reliance's Underground Coal Gasification complex in Eluru district is about:
new.x: Reliance's UCG complex is about ₹2.73 lakh crore over 30 years in 3 phases.

new.s: The Phase I capacity of JSW Rayalaseema Steel at Kadapa is:
new.x: Phase I is 1 MTPA, expanded to 2 MTPA in Phase II.

new.s: The annual capacity of the ASIP OSAT unit at Tarluvada, Visakhapatnam, is about:
new.x: The ASIP unit has a capacity of about 96 million chips a year.

new.s: The 50 Indian Gaurs proposed to be brought to Andhra Pradesh are from:
new.x: The 50 Indian Gaurs come from Madhya Pradesh, not Maharashtra.

new.s: The 10 new medical colleges planned in Andhra Pradesh under PPP will start from:
new.x: The 10 new medical colleges come up under PPP from 2027-28.

new.s: Which of the following towns is among the 10 new PPP medical colleges in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Madanapalle is among the 10 (with Adoni, Markapuram, Pulivendula, Penugonda, Palakollu, Amalapuram, Narsipatnam, Bapatla, Parvatipuram).

new.s:
Consider the following statements about metro rail Phase-I approved by Andhra Pradesh in December 2024:
1. The Vijayawada metro has 34 stations.
2. The Visakhapatnam metro has 2 corridors.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Vijayawada metro has 2 corridors and 34 stations; Visakhapatnam has 4 corridors over 76.90 km.

new.s: The built-up area of the Central Government General Pool Office Accommodation Project approved for Amaravati is:
new.x: The project, costing about ₹1,299 crore, has a built-up area of 23.2 lakh sq ft.
